allOf.description: Inherits shared step-base properties ($schema, id, owner, created_at, canonical_refs_used).

capabilities.description: Array of system capabilities derived from the charter, each with scope and traceability.

items.description: A single capability describing what the system can do, with inputs, outputs, and error states.

capability_id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for this capability (e.g., 'cap-user-login').

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what this capability does.

scope.description: Whether this capability is in-scope, out-of-scope, or planned for future delivery.

owner.description: Team or domain responsible for implementing this capability.

inputs.description: Data or signals required to exercise this capability.

outputs.description: Data or effects produced when this capability executes successfully.

preconditions.description: Conditions that must be true before this capability can execute.

postconditions.description: Conditions guaranteed to be true after successful execution of this capability.

error_states.description: Possible error conditions that may arise during capability execution.

items.description: An error state that may occur during capability execution.

trace.description: Traceability links back to upstream artifacts (e.g., charter segments, stakeholders).

items.description: A traceability reference for this capability.

capability_ref.description: Canonical reference linking this capability to the canonical registry.

action_ref.description: Canonical reference to the action verb used in this capability.

entity_ref.description: Canonical reference to the primary entity this capability operates on.

role_ref.description: Canonical reference to the role that exercises this capability.
